actual.descripcion: Durante 1977-1981, The Police realizó una gira verdaderamente mundial que los llevó a través de más de una docena de países, incluidos muchos a los que la mayoría de las bandas de rock de la época no podrían llegar. Esta película presenta lo más destacado de la gira, que incluye paradas en Japón, Hong Kong, India, Egipto, Australia y América Latina. Las 16 canciones que aparecen en esta película se grabaron en vivo durante la gira. Sin embargo, esto es más que un video concierto de rock, incluidas muchas tomas humorísticas fuera del escenario que muestran a la banda probando algunos de los lugares de interés, las costumbres y la cultura de las tierras que sus fanáticos llaman hogar.

lista.titulo: Eric Clapton & Steve Winwood - Live from Madison Square Garden • Live from MSG
lista.descripcion: Live from MSG | History rocked and rock made history during a sold-out three-gig stand at Madison Square Garden in late February 2008 when icons Eric Clapton and Steve Winwood performed a concert together for the first time since their all-too-brief days in the legendary Blind Faith in 1969. Whether they will ever team again is unknown. But with Eric Clapton and Steve Winwood Live From Madison Square Garden fans everywhere are able to experience the sound and the glory of a performance on that famous stage by two of rock's greatest artists.

Bastille | The Reading and Leeds Festivals are a pair of annual music festivals that take place in Reading and Leeds, England. The events both happen on the bank holiday weekend in August (on Friday, Saturday, Sunday), and share the same bill (occasionally with one or two exceptions). The festival's origins date to the Beaulieu Jazz Festival (1956–1961) which became the National Jazz Festival in 1961 (The National Jazz and Blues Festival in 1963) and settled in Reading in 1971. In 1999 a second leg was added at Leeds. Featuring : Bastille.

lista.titulo: Milky Chance - Garorock Festival 2017 • Garorock Festival
lista.descripcion: Garorock Festival | The German duet is back and better than ever! Milky Chance is the success story of two school friends, Clemens Rehbein and Philipp Dausch. After a long break, 2017 marks the release of a second, long-waited, album "Blossom". And, for the public, finally the occasion to discover live these new compositions, mixing rock, folk and electro pop. With reggae vibrations that can rub shoulders with house elements, Milky Chance has one of the most singular sounds. With the presence of musicians on stage, and if we believe the listening of the new record, we can expect more electric concerts, more electronic and even more energetic than in the past!
